publication.author: Hüseyin Ateş
publication.title: Comparing three instructional arrangements for immersive and desktop science learning: A multischool cluster-randomized trial of conceptual understanding and delayed transfer
publication.summary_basis: Study scope from the published title; no unverified results or effect sizes.

summary.en: A multischool cluster-randomized study comparing three instructional arrangements for immersive and desktop science learning, with conceptual understanding and delayed transfer as outcomes.
summary.tr: Sürükleyici ve masaüstü fen öğrenmesinde üç öğretim düzenlemesini karşılaştıran; kavramsal anlama ve gecikmeli transferi inceleyen, birden fazla okulda yürütülmüş küme randomize çalışma.
summary.de: Eine schulübergreifende cluster-randomisierte Studie zu drei Unterrichtsarrangements für immersives und desktopbasiertes naturwissenschaftliches Lernen mit konzeptuellem Verständnis und verzögertem Transfer als Ergebnissen.

cost.title: European Network for Developing and Evaluating the Use of GenAI in Education
cost.membership_source: Owner-supplied academic CV and membership announcement, reviewed 25 November 2026

summary.en: Hüseyin Ateş contributes to the European network on the development and evaluation of generative AI in education through working groups on evaluation and metrics, pedagogy and critical GenAI literacy.
summary.tr: Hüseyin Ateş, eğitimde üretken yapay zekânın geliştirilmesi ve değerlendirilmesine odaklanan Avrupa araştırma ağına değerlendirme ve ölçütler ile pedagoji ve eleştirel üretken yapay zekâ okuryazarlığı çalışma gruplarında katkı sunuyor.
summary.de: Hüseyin Ateş beteiligt sich am europäischen Netzwerk zur Entwicklung und Bewertung generativer KI in der Bildung in den Arbeitsgruppen zu Bewertung und Messgrößen sowie zu Pädagogik und kritischer GenAI-Kompetenz.
